2000.notes: Figo 197 pts, Zidane 181, Shevchenko 85. Nesta and Rivaldo tied 5th (39); Maldini and Beckham tied 10th (10) — Planet Football lists them as 11th. Convention: gp/g/uG include every league and European game played in the calendar year (from both editions); uT/uS refer to the edition ending in the year. UCL formats: 16-team group stage (1994–97) and second group stage (1999–2003) = 1; 24-team groups (1997–99) and first group stage (1999–) = 0. No FF retroactive award (from 1995 non-Europeans were already eligible).
